display.comparison_rule: Raw brightness value, mode, timeout and refresh settings must match across repeat runs.

performance_network.comparison_rule: All values must match; the SIM identifier is never recorded.

idle_network.comparison_rule: Connection state and material outages are recorded; SSID, subscriber and cell identifiers are excluded.

connected_power.note: Launch, frame and thermal measurements retain USB ADB. Power-source and charge-counter observations are recorded before and after.

idle_power.usb: physically disconnected after the start capture and reconnected only for the finish capture
idle_power.note: Logical USB disable is not accepted as proof that VBUS charging stopped.

procedures.units: seconds from a declared trigger to separately named boot milestones
procedures.method: Keep ordinary restart timing separate from physical cold power-on timing. For restart, measure on the host monotonic clock from issuing one allowlisted adb reboot until the mapped device disappears, returns authorized, reports sys.boot_completed=1 and exposes boot-animation completion as either service.bootanim.exit=1 or init.svc.bootanim=stopped. Record which property supplied the completion signal and preserve all three raw samples and every milestone. For cold power-on, use continuous source media that visibly binds the physical power-button press to the first usable stock UI; do not substitute USB enumeration or a software reboot for the physical start event.

cold_power_on.trigger: physical power-button press from a verified powered-off state
cold_power_on.timing_source: continuous fixed-frame-rate source media or an equivalent independently reviewable recording
cold_power_on.start_event: first frame showing the physical power-button press
cold_power_on.end_event: first frame showing the stock UI visibly ready for ordinary interaction

procedures.method: For each exact component, HOME then am force-stop plus am start -W is cold. Finish the measured cold activity with BACK, require its package process to remain resident, then use am start -W for warm. Require positive timing and the matching Android launch state. App data is never cleared.
Reset package-scoped gfxinfo counters, open Settings and alternate deterministic vertical swipes before collecting package-scoped framestats.
Capture start state, explicitly reset batterystats, physically disconnect USB, leave the screen off for the fixed interval, reconnect once and immediately capture end state plus batterystats.

procedures.units: degC and Android thermal status over elapsed seconds
procedures.method: Run four bounded toybox dd zero-to-null workers while sampling dumpsys thermalservice; then sample through a fixed cooldown. Preserve Android throttling and abort conservatively without overriding thermal policy.

observation_sources: dumpsys thermalservice current HAL temperatures and Android thermal status
fixed_parameters.safety_sensor_source: dumpsys thermalservice current HAL battery and skin readings

procedures.units: Linux PSI averages and cumulative microseconds
procedures.method: Capture bounded meminfo, vmstat, LMKD-tagged logs, activity kill events and the PSI permission/result around the fixed connected sequence. Treat unavailable PSI explicitly and do not infer LMKD kills from uncorroborated activity events.

fixed_parameters.lmkd_event_source: logcat lmkd and lowmemorykiller tags bounded to the run start
fixed_parameters.activity_kill_event_source: logcat events am_kill and am_low_memory tags bounded to the run start
fixed_parameters.unavailable_rule: A permission-denied PSI read on a locked stock user build is UNSUPPORTED with raw stderr retained; it is never converted to zero.
fixed_parameters.interpretation: Meminfo and kernel-counter deltas plus bounded event logs are observations of the fixed connected sequence. Activity-manager kill events are not labelled LMKD kills without a matching LMKD record or explicit reason. No causal claim is made from these counters alone.

procedures.units: original media files plus SHA-256 and recorded conditions
procedures.method: Operator captures a privacy-safe fixed enclosed-box scene from one marked stand position. Lamp setting, camera-facing orientation, distance, camera/lens/mode and focus action are recorded for every original file; no beauty filter or edit is applied.

fixed_parameters.subject: fixed green timer and Johnson's Buds blue box with its front text visible
fixed_parameters.focus: tap the center of the green timer dial before every capture
fixed_parameters.lighting_control: USB lamp powered by the MacBook, fixed to the box with its cable secured externally; operate the manual inline controls outside the closed box and claim no programmable interface. Its reproducible controls are three cyclic colour modes and ten discrete brightness levels: colour mode 1 is operator-labelled neutral white, mode 2 cool white, and mode 3 warm. These are repeatable control labels, not measured colour temperatures.

capture_defaults.hdr: stock camera-managed default; the displayed HDR badge is not exposed as an actionable accessibility control
capture_defaults.source_media: retain the exact camera-generated file without edit, conversion or metadata rewrite

fixture.room_control: blinds and door closed; room light off
fixture.controller_host: MacBook controls the phone over ADB and powers the USB lamp
fixture.phone_position: one marked stand-base position; align it to the fixture markings and reference photographs and do not move the base between captures
fixture.rear_orientation: screen faces away from the subjects so the rear cameras face them
fixture.front_orientation: phone is reversed 180 degrees in the same marked stand so the screen and front camera face the subjects
fixture.stability_control: mark the Buds box and stand positions; align the stand and timer to the fixture and reference photographs before closing the enclosure; millimetre-scale repositioning variation is accepted and must not be described as exact registration

scenes.color: cyclic colour mode 1 of 3; operator-labelled neutral white
cyclic colour mode 3 of 3; operator-labelled warm
cyclic colour mode 1 of 3; operator-labelled neutral white

advertised_mode_survey.policy: Inventory every exposed control. Retain one original per applicable additional still-image control under colour mode 1 at brightness 10; record any runtime rejection or unavailable lens/mode combination explicitly rather than inferring support.

not_applicable.reason: requires camera movement and would invalidate the fixed stand position
